strategy.reason_selected: Rejected alternative: Gate health route absent from canonical registry, no default candidate loader/scheduler/queue dispatch, read-side paid action, EIE process-local target queue and uncalibrated ROI.
strategy.reversibility: Keep code defaults OFF and no deployment changes; runtime kill switches cancel scheduled/queued work with evidence retained; versioned rollback only after later approval.
strategy.future_seam: After source-owner approval, operator may independently activate read-only health, then paid enrichment and graph feedback in bounded tenant-specific rollout. No Odoo commercial dependency.

delivery.migration_plan: No automatic DB migration or graph rewrite. Reuse existing persistence until durable inbox proof shows a bounded additive schema is unavoidable. If new state, versioned tenant/operation records preserving previously accepted feedback and source identity, with migration and rollback tested before use.
delivery.recovery_plan: Flags remain OFF. Later shutdown pauses leader/scheduler, atomically prevents new dispatch, preserves pending receipts and stops stale retries. Kill switch proven against queued jobs, then redeploy last accepted builds; reconcile missed work with source versions.
delivery.release_boundary: Read-only planning only; no code/PR/merge/deploy/spend permission, no flags changed. After all code and runtime proofs, issue READY BUT DISABLED; require separate operator-specific activation command at exact release and tenant.
